verdict.name: Used syringe or needle
steps: Never recap or bend the needle
Put it in a hard plastic bottle with a tight lid
Give it to a hospital, pharmacy or special care collection point
verdict.drop_off_text: Hand it to your city's special care (household hazardous) waste collection or drop-off centre.
verdict.impact: Loose needles injure waste workers and can spread infection.
